svg.aria-label: Ayushman Gupta. Full-stack engineer in India. I build the tools I got tired of waiting for: a database client, and a reading list that lives in my terminal. By day, I work on insurance software at Neo. Now shipping Seqora; learning Rust and agent workflows; off hours, astronomy and sketching.
